oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an Oil Control System (if so equipped) that calculates engine oil and filter change intervals based on driving conditions. Severe driving conditions shorten the oil and filter change interval. If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change the engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). The system is described in the Vehicle Information Display sections (Type A: p. 2-23; Type B: p. 2-41) and the Maintenance Schedules section (p. 9-7).
severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
extraction_caveats:
1. TWO SEPARATE SCHEDULES: The manual contains two distinct maintenance schedules — one for the PR25DD (2.5L, pages ~541–559, using 10,000-mile/12-month base intervals) and one for the KR20DDET (2.0L VC-Turbo, pages ~562–572, using 7,500-mile/12-month base intervals). Intervals reported reflect each engine's own schedule.

2. ENGINE OIL INTERVAL: The PR25DD schedule shows oil changes at 10,000-mile/12-month intervals. The KR20DDET schedule shows oil changes at 7,500-mile/12-month intervals. The Oil Control System may shorten these intervals.

3. IN-CABIN MICROFILTER: PR25DD appears at 20k, 30k, 45k, 75k, 80k, 90k, 105k — not perfectly uniform. KR20DDET appears at every 11,250-mile/18-month interval.

4. BRAKE FLUID: PR25DD standard schedule shows replacement at 20k, 30k, 40k, 80k, 100k; severe adds 50k, 60k, 90k, 110k. KR20DDET shows brake fluid replacement at nearly every interval (both standard and severe).

5. INTELLIGENT KEY BATTERY: PR25DD appears at 30k, 45k, 75k, 80k, 90k, 105k. KR20DDET appears at 22.5k, 45k, 56.25k, 67.5k, 78.75k, 90k.

6. CVT FLUID: Listed as inspection item at major service intervals. CVT fluid replacement appears only in KR20DDET severe schedule at 60,000 miles/96 months.

7. FUEL CAPACITY: Page 576 shows fuel tank capacity as FWD: 16-1/4 gal, AWD: 16 gal (not engine-specific).

8. ENGINE COOLANT CAPACITY: Page 576 shows coolant 'with reservoir' as PR25DD: 2-1/4 gal, KR20DDET: 2-1/8 gal.

9. SPARK PLUGS: Only shown in PR25DD schedule at 105,000 miles/126 months. KR20DDET schedule pages provided do not show a spark plug replacement milestone within the excerpted range (up to 90k).

10. ENGINE COOLANT: First replacement at 105,000 miles or 84 months; repeat interval is 75,000 miles or 60 months.

11. DIFFERENTIAL/TRANSFER FLUID: No capacity figures listed (shown as dashes). Transfer fluid listed as separate line in page 577 table alongside differential gear oil with same spec.

12. BRAKE LINES AND CABLES, FUEL TANK VAPOR VENT, FUEL LINES/CONNECTIONS: These items appear at different intervals for PR25DD vs KR20DDET schedules and have been split accordingly.

13. PROPELLER SHAFT: AWD only. Appears in both standard and severe inspection schedules for PR25DD. KR20DDET schedule pages provided do not show propeller shaft (no AWD for VC-Turbo in provided pages).
